uv.d: radiation lying in the ultraviolet range; wave lengths shorter than light but longer than X rays

uvea.d: the part of the eye that contains the iris and ciliary body and choroid

uveal.d: of or relating to the uvea of the eye

uveitis.d: inflammation of the uvea of the eye

uveoscleral pathway.d: a tubule that drains excess aqueous humor

uveous.d: of or relating to the uvea of the eye

uvula.d: a small pendant fleshy lobe at the back of the soft palate

uvular.d: of or relating to or associated with the uvula

uvularia.d: genus of perennial rhizomatous herb of southern and southeastern United States

uvularia grandiflora.d: plant of southern and southeastern United States grown for its yellow flowers that can be dried

uvulariaceae.d: one of many subfamilies into which some classification systems subdivide the Liliaceae

uvulopalatopharyngoplasty.d: surgical resection of unnecessary palatal and oropharyngeal tissue to open the airway; intended to cure extreme cases of snoring (with or without sleep apnea)
